breaking_news.headline: These swing voters are adding high gas prices into their political calculations
breaking_news.summary: As part of NPR's Swing Shift project checking in with swing voters, these Americans are split on who is to blame for high gas prices but they all agree it has an impact on their personal finances.

breaking_news.headline: Trump wants a gas tax holiday. There's a much bigger problem looming
breaking_news.summary: Suspending the federal gasoline tax could save drivers up to 18.4 cents per gallon. But it would drain the fund meant to cover roadbuilding and repairs — a fund that's already in trouble.

breaking_news.headline: This is how close American households are to the financial edge
breaking_news.summary: A new report shows that nearly half of U.S. households did not earn enough to cover their necessities in 2024.

breaking_news.headline: FIFA's World Cup ticket sales outraged fans. Now they are under investigation
breaking_news.summary: FIFA has always had a peculiar way to sell tickets to the World Cup. It never faced any major issues — until prices soared for the 2026 tournament.

breaking_news.headline: CBS' Bari Weiss overhauls '60 Minutes,' fires top producer and reporters
breaking_news.summary: The new head of CBS News is flexing her muscles at the network's most storied news program: "60 Minutes." We look at the upheaval.

breaking_news.headline: Here's how we're coping with high gas prices, according to Costco and Walmart
breaking_news.summary: Sky-high gas prices have drivers going out of their way for discounts at the pump. Oil executives warn that even higher prices might be on the horizon.

breaking_news.headline: United Airlines flight to Spain pulls U-turn, apparently over Bluetooth device name
breaking_news.summary: The flight to Palma de Mallorca diverted back to Newark late on Saturday. Air traffic audio and social media posts indicate an onboard Bluetooth device raised security concerns.

breaking_news.headline: One by one, U.S. civil rights agency dismantles tools to fight discrimination
breaking_news.summary: The EEOC is seeking to overturn rules created decades ago to tackle discrimination in employment. The Trump administration says those rules have led to more discrimination —against white people.

breaking_news.headline: Litterbugs now face on-the-spot fines in Tokyo's tourist hotspot
breaking_news.summary: Dozens of officials will patrol world-famous Shibuya as Japan responds to the impacts of overtourism.

breaking_news.headline: Poland's controversial 'Highway to Hel' 666 bus revived
breaking_news.summary: Poland's seaside resort called Hel is getting its 666 bus service back, despite earlier opposition from Christian groups.

breaking_news.headline: France seized sanctioned Russian oil tanker with UK help, Macron says
breaking_news.summary: A British helicopter provided support during the operation on Sunday, the UK ministry of defence says.

breaking_news.headline: Five patients recover from Ebola in DR Congo and leave hospital
breaking_news.summary: Those infected can get better and officials stress that people should seek medical help if they have symptoms.

breaking_news.headline: Huge blast kills dozens in rebel-held village in Myanmar
breaking_news.summary: Insurgents say it was caused by explosives being used for mining close to the Chinese border.

breaking_news.headline: Israel PM orders strikes on Beirut suburbs as Hezbollah conflict escalates
breaking_news.summary: Benjamin Netanyahu says the Hezbollah stronghold of Dahieh will be targeted in response to attacks on Israeli civilians.

breaking_news.headline: Iran attacks damage 20 US military sites since start of war, satellite images show
breaking_news.summary: Analysts told BBC Verify that Tehran's strikes were more extensive than publicly acknowledged.

breaking_news.headline: US says it struck Iranian radar sites as Kuwait reports missile and drone attacks
breaking_news.summary: Iran and the US say they have carried out fresh strikes around the Strait of Hormuz, with Kuwait condemning "repeated" Iranian attacks.

breaking_news.headline: Secret tunnels and unregistered workers: China's coal mine disaster is a reminder of darker days
breaking_news.summary: China's worst coal mining disaster in 15 years comes amid an ambitious pivot towards green energy.

breaking_news.headline: A year of grief after Air India crash: What remains when a plane falls from the sky
breaking_news.summary: A mother still speaks about her son who died in the crash in the present tense and a brother waits for answers.

breaking_news.headline: Caribbean hot sauce producers warn of shortages and higher prices
breaking_news.summary: Manufacturers in Jamaica say the key chilli peppers they need are in limited supply.

breaking_news.headline: Why is Lidl opening a pub?
breaking_news.summary: The debate about about what seems like a bizarre idea of having a cold pint after exploring the store's well known middle aisle.
